acceptance.failure: Missing quiet baseline, missing pre-read absolute anchor, an unconfirmed action, missing fresh frame evidence, or a final visual return above 3 px terminates the run. Neither motion command is retried. No preset or visual correction is allowed.
acceptance.success: A single tilt pulse has a sent-to-visual timeline containing fresh decoder sequence evidence and controller lifecycle states, and one absolute return matches the anchor within 3 px. The result may classify the tilt response as not observed; that is an explicit result, not a successful coverage connection.

hypothesis: The E9P2 vertical inconsistency can be separated into controller Stop serialization, decoder timing, and absent or delayed visual tilt response when observation starts at command send rather than after a fixed quiet-grace delay.

result.interpretation: The data proves a local command/decoder-observation gap. Without a camera exposure timestamp, mechanical delay and upstream video delay remain classified together as inconclusive.
